description: Full-text search over this Space's messages, Articles, live Board labels, Parking ideas, bibliography papers (title and authors), and live file-offer filenames. Optional campaign_id limits messages, Board, and file hits to that Campaign; Articles, Parking, and papers stay Space-wide. Read-only: does not advance the unread cursor. Idempotent.

campaign_id.description: Campaign (a named workstream in this Space) to use; omit for the Space's default Campaign. Ids come from list_campaigns.
